stem.en: February averages: Thiruvananthapuram 27.3 °C, Chennai 25.7 °C, Mumbai 24.4 °C, Delhi 16.7 °C. June averages: Jodhpur 33.9 °C, Delhi 33.3 °C, Chennai 32.5 °C, Thiruvananthapuram 26.6 °C. Which are the two hottest stations in each month?

text.en: February: Thiruvananthapuram, Chennai. June: Jodhpur, Delhi

feedback.en: Yes. The south is hottest in February and the north-west in June.

text.en: February: Jodhpur, Delhi. June: Thiruvananthapuram, Chennai

feedback.en: No. This swaps the two months.

text.en: February: Chennai, Mumbai. June: Delhi, Chennai

feedback.en: No. Each of these skips the hottest station of the month.

text.en: February: Thiruvananthapuram, Delhi. June: Jodhpur, Thiruvananthapuram

feedback.en: No. Delhi is coolest in the February list, and Thiruvananthapuram in the June list.

explanation.en: In February the Sun's heat is strongest near the equator, so Thiruvananthapuram (27.3) and Chennai (25.7) lead. By June the inland north-west is hottest: Jodhpur (33.9) and Delhi (33.3).

hints.en: Pick the two biggest numbers in the February list.
Do the same for the June list.
